limitations: Exactly three independent uniform arclength samples from one finite horocycle segment in curvature -1.

No uniform rates, higher-dimensional or nonuniform-density generalization, or definitive historical-priority claim.
title: A Pareto area-deficit law for triangles sampled on expanding hyperbolic horocycles
